prd_summary: Cross-functional operational pipeline executing sequential and interleaved tasks across Blender, Vscode. Requires strict state continuity, rigorous verification of intermediate deliverables, and accurate tracking of task interruptions and resumptions.

active_tickets.acceptance_criteria: Mesh normals unified, base color texture linked, transforms normalized.

active_tickets.title: Vscode: Validate Schema Models & Implement Unit Tests
active_tickets.acceptance_criteria: Guard clauses implemented, pytest passes 100% green without regressions.

blender.validation_rule: Mesh normals unified, base color texture linked, transforms normalized.

domain_constraints: All intermediate work-in-progress must be saved before switching application contexts.
When an interruption occurs, the primary task state must be preserved and cleanly resumed.
Final outputs must be validated against ticket acceptance criteria.
